We need answer Chinese grammar question. Need identify which sentence is not object fronting (宾语前置). Options:
A. 姜氏何厌之有? (What satiety does Jiang have? 何厌之有 = 有何厌, object 何厌 fronted with 之 marker)
B. 斥鷃笑之曰：“彼且奚适也?” (Where will he go? 奚适 = 适奚, interrogative pronoun object fronted)
C. 居则曰：“不吾知也!” (They don't know me? 不吾知 = 不知吾, negation sentence first-person pronoun object fronted)
D. 胡不见我于王? (Why not introduce me to the king? 见我 = introduce me, object 我 normal? 胡不 见我 于王. 胡 is adverb interrogative 'why', not object. So not object fronting.)
Need final line 答案：D. Provide maybe concise explanation. Ensure last line exactly format. Need maybe discuss. Final in Chinese.
content:
“胡不见我于王？”中，“胡”是疑问副词，相当于“为什么”，不是宾语；“我”在动词“见”之后，属于正常语序，不属于宾语前置。

答案：D
